core_hypothesis: Hodgson's zoological establishment operated partly as a paper office in which local behavioural observations were translated, serialized and linked by numbers to visual paper objects. The identifier system made distributed labour and evidence reconnectable, while later sheet-count evidence demonstrates that relational identifiers and physical paper units formed different ontologies and must be reconciled only through direct historical mappings.
